user_question: Calculate mean elevation for every census tract that intersects State College borough.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Calculate mean elevation for every census tract that intersects State College borough.

workflow_steps.title: Retrieve census tract polygons
workflow_steps.purpose: Obtain a census tract polygon dataset covering State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Retrieve the highest-ranked available census tract polygon dataset covering State College borough. Return the dataset with its available metadata for downstream suitability evaluation.

workflow_steps.title: Select census tracts intersecting State College borough
workflow_steps.purpose: Create polygon zones for every census tract that intersects the State College borough boundary.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform an intersection overlay between the retrieved census tract dataset and the supplied State College borough boundary. Preserve census tract identity attributes and output the intersecting tract features as a GeoPackage layer.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate mean elevation by intersecting census tract
workflow_steps.purpose: Calculate mean elevation for every census tract intersecting State College borough.
workflow_steps.instructions: Compute mean zonal statistics for the intersecting census tract polygons using the supplied DEM raster candidate that provides adequate spatial coverage. Evaluate the supplied raster candidates using runtime metadata and do not guess when raster selection, coverage, or CRS compatibility is consequential. Produce a CSV summary keyed by census tract attributes.

requirements.scope: The retrieved census tract dataset must cover State College borough and provide census tract polygon features.
The retrieved census tract layer and State College borough boundary must have compatible coordinate reference systems before overlay.
The census tract polygons used for overlay must have valid, non-empty geometries.
The selected DEM raster and intersecting census tract zones must have matching or otherwise compatible coordinate reference systems for zonal statistics.
At least one supplied DEM raster must cover every intersecting census tract zone used for the requested means.

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Vector Analysis A
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic vector geoprocessing including buffering, clipping, overlay/intersection, explicit geometry repair, and spatial joins. Binary spatial operations require compatible coordinate reference systems. Distance operations use the coordinate system and units of the provided input artifact.

skills.name: Vector Geoprocessing
skills.description: Performs spatial buffering, clipping, polygon intersection overlay, geometry validation/repair, and spatial joins.

constraints.spatial: Requires matching coordinate reference systems for binary operations. Distance operations require projected coordinate reference systems.
other: The service performs only the requested operation.
It does not automatically reproject inputs or repair geometries unless explicitly requested.

input_datasets.description: One or two vector datasets in GeoPackage (.gpkg) or GeoJSON format.

operation.description: Explicit operation name (buffer, clip, overlay, geometry_repair, spatial_join).

agent_profile_snapshot.name: Raster Analysis Agent
agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic raster reprojection, resampling, clipping, raster calculation, and zonal statistics. Consumes GeoTIFF rasters and GeoPackage polygon zones.

skills.name: Raster Geoprocessing
skills.description: Executes raster calculations, reprojections, grid resampling, spatial masking, and zonal aggregations.

constraints.spatial: Raster calculation requires compatible grid definitions and CRS. Zonal statistics require matching CRS between raster and GeoPackage zones.
other: Accepts GeoTIFF (.tif) rasters and GeoPackage (.gpkg) polygon zones.
Does not accept GeoJSON zones for zonal statistics.

input_datasets.description: GeoTIFF raster file(s) and optional GeoPackage polygon zone layer.

operation.description: Explicit operation (zonal_statistics, raster_calculator, resample, clip, reproject_raster).

resolution.description: Target pixel resolution in meters for resampling.

target_crs.description: Target coordinate reference system for raster reprojection.
